messages:
morgan: Quick Q from Caroline  Two related items: 1) Sam (currently on parental leave) is being promoted IC -> Manager with an effective date 2026-10-01 while still on leave; 2) separate case: converting contractor Lee to FT with manager-level title starting 10/01 and sign-on equity. Need clarity on payroll cutoffs, backpay mechanics for someone on leave, whether parental leave pay continuity is affected, benefits retroactive enrollments, and any tax/onboarding paperwork differences for contractor conversion. Who owns what docs?
caroline: For Sam: we want the promotion effective 10/1 so manager training stipend/manager payroll code apply when they return. For Lee: manager wants start 10/1 with prorated sign-on RSUs + 401k eligibility start.
sam: I'm on paid parental leave through 10/15. Will a promotion change my leave pay or delay my return-to-work paperwork? Also curious if backpay will be a lump or split (payroll prefers one-liners).
ivy: Legal note: promotions while on approved leave are allowed. Parental leave benefit (company-paid portion) continues per policy and shouldn't be clawed back. If base pay increases while on leave, payroll needs to reconcile any difference for the leave period if the leave benefits are salary-based. We'll need to check whether your leave pay is flat or salary-proportional.
morgan: Good call. Payroll, does our leave pay formula use base salary at time leave started or current base?
payroll-bot: Payroll: leave pay for Redwood's parental policy is calculated on base salary at the time leave was approved. If a compensation change occurs during leave, we do not retroactively increase leave payments already paid, but we can issue backpay to align balances if requested. For an effective 2026-10-01 change while on leave, backpay can be issued as a single lump-sum labeled "Promotion Backpay - Sam" once comp change is processed.
caroline: So we won't change already-paid leave installments, but we can top up via backpay if team requests. Good. What are cutoffs to get salary changed for Oct 1 and backpay timing?
payroll-bot: To reflect a 10/01 effective in the Oct payroll run enter HR job change by 2026-09-30 COB (payroll cutoff 2026-10-01 run). If missed, submit off-cycle by 2026-10-02 COB; off-cycle processing ~3 business days. For promotions, off-cycle fee is waived. Backpay calculation: prorate from 10/01 to payroll date; for leave periods we calculate difference between old and new leave pay if applicable and include in same lump-sum.
benefits: Benefits ops: enrollment windows for newly eligible programs (medical, 401k, FSAs) tie to HR effective date. If someone is on leave, they can still enroll; coverages start based on payroll deduction timing. For contractor->FT conversion, you must submit new hire packet + I-9 (US) and W-4 before first payroll to avoid tax/payment issues.
caroline: For Lee (contractor -> FT): any special deadlines to hit 10/01 start and have sign-on equity/grant date as 10/01? Also need to know if we can retroactively date equity if paperwork lags.
morgan: Also need to confirm whether contractor service months count toward RSU vesting start or if vesting restarts on FT start.
ivy: For equity: contractor time typically does not count toward employee RSU vesting unless specified in offer. Comp committee must approve any backdating or crediting of service. To request a 10/01 grant date, submit comp packet by 2026-09-29 COB for committee review. If approval is later, grant date will reflect committee approval date.
payroll-bot: For contractor conversion: ensure Recruiting sends "Offer Acceptance" + signed equity docs and HR creates employee record before payroll cutoff 2026-09-30. Also need completed I-9, W-4, and direct deposit. If those are late, first payment may be delayed and contractor payments may need to be reconciled via AP.
caroline: For Lee's sign-on RSUs, manager wants prorated grant for the remainder of the year and cliffing schedule aligned to normal manager grants. Is there a standard proration?
morgan: Generally we prorate the first-year award by days remaining in the fiscal year and then follow standard annual grants. But comp committee decides final.
ivy: Right  include proposed proration formula in packet (days remaining / 365 * target), plus business rationale and approval. Packets due 9/29 for 10/1 grant date consideration.
sam: Action for me: I don't want my leave payments changed unexpectedly. Who signs off on any backpay/top-up?
morgan: We'll only top-up if you request. Caroline, you'll confirm with Sam whether to issue backpay to make leave payments reflect new salary for the leave period. If yes, include note in comp change request. Payroll will then calculate difference and issue lump-sum.
caroline: I'll confirm with Sam and add note. Action items recap?
morgan: 1) Caroline to confirm with Sam whether to top-up leave payments and collect signed Comp Change Request (Sam) by 2026-09-28 COB. 2) Recruiting/HR to submit Lee's conversion packet + hire paperwork (I-9, W-4, equity docs) by 2026-09-30 COB to hit 10/01 payroll. 3) Manager to submit comp committee packet for any manager RSU requests by 2026-09-29 COB. 4) Payroll will process promotion backpay as single lump-sum and waive off-cycle fee for promotions. 5) Legal to review any contractor service credit requests. I'll post a checklist doc after this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
